SG7
Mechanical Systems Support

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

You will be responsible for performing a high building systems and equipment operation and maintenance for all facility and utility related equipment. This includes equipment that supplies critical and emergency utilities for manufacturing areas and all the local support functions at the Drug Delivery and Penicillin buildings.
This position ensures equipment is well maintained by performing on time completion of Preventive and Predictive Maintenance, monitoring of building systems and alarms to respond and address conditions before they result in an impact to plant operations.

Baxter is passionate about saving and sustaining lives by finding solutions to sophisticated problems. Every single day, the manufacturing team strives to create quality products for our customers—and are sometimes met with unforeseen issues to tackle. The high-caliber talent at Baxter meets these challenges head-on, as a team, to create products with the customer's needs top-of-mind.
We provide opportunities for you to continue to learn through training, conferences, certifications, and support for advanced degrees. Growth from role to role or level to level is encouraged and is supported by management to ensure employees are consistently engaged with their work.

You will work independently to complete maintenance activities while continuously building your technical knowledge and skills through training and hands-on experience. You will take a proactive approach to safety, lead by example, and follow plant and corporate procedures related to critical facility systems, equipment, GMP, and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) to support reliable manufacturing operations.
Responsible for daily checks and maintenance activities in the facility areas.
Conducts preventive and planned maintenance activities as the need arises.
Responsible for knowing and following all safety and compliance requirements and maintaining cleanliness within work area.
Follows written instructions such as standard operating procedures and preventive maintenance instructions and performs proper record keeping following Good Documentation Practices (GDP) including accurate and timely documentation.
Trouble-shoots, repairs and maintains a wide range of equipment, such as boilers, air compressor, stills, air handlers, motors, programmable logic controller (PLC) systems (Siemens, Allen Bradley, etc.), temperature controllers, variable speed drives, and electrical systems up to 480v, 3ph.
Performs tasks such as equipment relocations, crating or uncrating of parts, mechanical adjustments and alignments, identifying and ordering of spare parts, documenting all work, clean-up before leaving job, attending relevant training and meetings.
Participates continuous improvement projects and upgrades.
Personal protective equipment must be worn in accordance with all safety requirements.
Periodic work in clean room environments wearing appropriate gowning.

A candidate must not be allergic to Penicillin and Cephalosporin or their related products and minerals.
High school diploma or GED equivalent required, technical certifications a plus.
Associates degree in a technical discipline or above a plus.

In a Nutshell
As a Senior Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d), you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord.

You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day.

During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.
The tricks of the trade
Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.
Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.
Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.
Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

You hold a Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
You have 5+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role
You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems
You are interested in working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team
At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way
You're fluent in English, German
What you can look forward to
Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.
Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.
Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.
Kickstart your career: Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized Lepaya trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact.
Sustainability at Core: Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste.
The Essentials: We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more.
Unforgettable Moments: From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style.
Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.

Technologie mit Sinn: Du arbeitest an Lösungen, bei denen IT-Sicherheit und gesellschaftliche Relevanz unmittelbar zusammenkommen. Deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, Sicherheits- und Kontrollsysteme an wichtigen europäischen Standorten zuverlässig zu betreiben.
Anspruchsvolle Aufgaben statt Routine: Dich erwarten komplexe technische Fragestellungen, internationale Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Projekte, bei denen Deine Erfahrung und Dein analytisches Denken gefragt sind.
Teamarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest in Teams, die auch anspruchsvolle und umfangreiche Projekte gemeinsam vorantreiben. Dabei bringst Du Deine Expertise ein und entwickelst Dich kontinuierlich weiter.
Individuelle Entwicklung: Deine berufliche Entwicklung wird nicht nach einem starren Standardmodell geplant. Stattdessen werden Möglichkeiten geschaffen, die zu Deinen fachlichen Interessen und persönlichen Zielen passen.
Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Je nach Aufgabe stehen Dir verschiedene Arbeitsmodelle zur Verfügung – darunter Mobile Office, Shared Desk, Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeitmodelle. Insgesamt gibt es zwölf Standorte in Deutschland.
Arbeiten innerhalb der EU: Du kannst bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr remote aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten – ideal, wenn Du Arbeit und einen längeren Aufenthalt im europäischen Ausland verbinden möchtest.
Vergütung: Das Jahreszielgehalt setzt sich aus einem attraktiven Fixgehalt und einer leistungsabhängigen Tantieme zusammen.
Zusätzliche Benefits: Dich erwarten unter anderem Bike-Leasing, ein Firmenfitnessprogramm, ein vergünstigtes Jobticket und weitere Mitarbeiterangebote

About One Acre Fund
Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services.

On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.
Our Kenya program, founded in 2006, operates under the local brand Tupande. Close to 500 staff in our Kakamega headquarters support 1,747 field staff and serve more than 1 million farmers. In Nairobi, around 50 staff support global functions like procurement, recruitment, government relations, and communications

Seeking an exceptional Electrical Engineer with 3-5 years experience to execute electrical maintenance, automation troubleshooting, and instrumentation repairs across all Tupande Soko factories and reduce operational downtime for our processing operations.

Hands-on Electrical Maintenance & Troubleshooting
Execute hands-on electrical repairs and wiring calibrations on critical processing machinery to ensure operational continuity across all plants.
Troubleshoot complex electrical faults, control panel failures, and circuitry issues directly, providing on-the-spot technical interventions when needed.
Diagnose, maintain, and program automated control loops, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), sensors, PLC inputs/outputs, and instrumentation.
Preventive Maintenance & Instrumentation Care
Physically execute electrical preventative maintenance schedules and calibration routines generated via the CMMS system.
Test distribution boards, manage load balancing, check safety relays, and inspect heating element arrays or electrical burners.
Maintain precise logs of electrical component changes, system modifications, and power quality metrics to share with the Lead Engineer.
Machinery Focus & Technical Verification
Diagnose and execute specialized electrical repairs on electrical systems embedded in Soko factory machinery.
Maintain electrical components on industrial dehydrators, complex macadamia sorting lines, and biochar manufacturing controls, etc.
Ensure correct electrical specifications (voltages, current ratings, IP ratings, phase requirements) are listed for machines, spare parts, and consumables requested.
Workforce Mentorship & Electrical Safety
Mentor and model safe electrical repair and testing techniques during direct floor interaction with factory operators and maintenance staff
Assist in delivering training to machine operators on basic autonomous maintenance checks focusing on electrical controls, emergency stops, and warning indicators.
Ensure safety and food safety compliance
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with safe systems of work: permit to work, LOTO, confined space, and relevant Kenyan regulatory requirements (KEBS, DOSH, NEMA)
Maintain HACCP-required equipment records for food-contact assets; lead the maintenance function's contribution to food safety audits
Champion a zero-harm safety culture; conduct regular safety walks and close out hazard reports
Career Growth and Development
We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You'll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You'll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.
Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for . For this role specifically, you will have:

Degree or Higher Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or Mechatronics engineering field.
Active technical registration or licensing to perform electrical works in Kenya (EPRA/DOSH alignment preferred).
Direct hands-on electrical fault-finding and root cause analysis on industrial plant equipment.
Experience troubleshooting automated components, electrical heaters, industrial dehydrators, and macadamia processing controls preferred.
Ability to utilize CMMS software to close out work orders and update electrical device logs.
CMMS operation and administration (SAP PM, Maximo, Limble, or equivalent).
Expert proficiency in interpreting industrial electrical schematics, wiring single/three-phase motors, and configuring instrumentation parameters.

Food safety management systems and HACCP requirements as applied to plant maintenance.
Kenyan electrical and occupational health and safety laws (OSHA, DOSH electrical standards).
TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) or World Class Manufacturing principles
Kenyan regulatory environment for food manufacturing (KEBS, relevant standards)

The position serves as a Collections Management Technician II and is located in the Stack Management Unit, Collections Maintenance and Stack Management Section, of the Collections Management Division (CMD), Preservation Directorate (PRES), Discovery and Preservation Services (DPS) within the Library Collections and Services Group (LCSG) at the Library of Congress (LC).

As a Collection Management Technician, you will: Follow extensive library rules, procedures and operations, retrieve materials from the collection. Apply judgement in retrieving materials. Receive retrieval requests through a number of methods including paper call slips, Automated Call Slip (ACS) and/or other automated request systems.

With some projects, follow general guidelines on what to pull, and must adhere to these guidelines which might include criteria such as item condition, date of publication, or format.

Follow a number of established procedures and specific guidelines available in the form of extensive library procedures, rules, and operations, perform an array of activities involved in maintaining the collections, including ensuring that collections are in the proper order, safe from hazards and readily retrievable when requested.

Use judgment to identify and select the most appropriate procedure to use, choose from among several established alternatives, or decide which precedent actions to follow as a model. Refer situations requiring significant judgment to the supervisor or others for guidance or resolution.

Arrange, sort and re-shelve materials returned to the stacks according to the prescribed order for that portion of the collection. Maintain assigned areas to ensure that each item is in proper order according to collections management and maintenance guidelines for each collection.

Frequent shelf reading of the collections, i.e., ensuring that the items on the shelves are in proper order, is a critical component of collections maintenance.

Use multiple shelving and classification arrangements including LC Classification, fixed location arrangement and others utilized by CMD to ensure that collections are properly shelved, arranged and accessible for use.

Use an in-depth or broad knowledge of a body of library regulations, procedures, and policies related collections retrieval to perform procedural duties or technical operation of limited scope and difficulty.

Provide enhanced book retrieval service, including quick searches for all Not-on-Shelf (NoS) responses for patrons, staff and priority clients, primarily CRS staff and Congressional patrons.

Identify and remove items suspected of containing errors in labeling and/or cataloging and forward items to the Preservation Directorate, the Acquisitions and Bibliographic Access Directorate, or other Library units for further determination or disposition.

Utilize and operate the Library's automated material handling systems used to sort and process collections. Operate the equipment as well as perform preventative maintenance on the machine(s).

Knowledge of library collections maintenance practices and procedures.** Ability to use computerized databases and search tools.** Knowledge of proper library collection retrieval processes and procedures. Ability to plan work and meet deadlines. Ability to interact collaboratively with others.

## TECHNICIEN DE MAINTENANCE ÉLECTROMÉCANIQUE - MOTEURS ÉLECTRIQUES ##
**Canton de Neuchâtel**
**Un moteur tombe en panne. Votre premier réflexe est de chercher pourquoi, pas simplement de remplacer la pièce ?**
Alors nous devrions nous parler.
Dans le cadre d'un recrutement pour l'un de nos partenaires industriels, nous recherchons un **technicien de maintenance électromécanique** capable d'intervenir sur des moteurs électriques et des équipements industriels, aussi bien sur la partie **électrique que mécanique**.
Ici, nous recherchons avant tout quelqu'un qui sait **diagnostiquer, démonter, comprendre, réparer et remettre en service**.
### Votre quotidien ###

* Le diagnostic de pannes électromécaniques
* Le démontage et remontage de moteurs électriques
* La recherche de défauts électriques et mécaniques
* Le contrôle des stators, rotors, roulements et différents composants
* Le remplacement et l'ajustement des éléments défectueux
* Les mesures électriques et contrôles d'isolement
* Les essais, contrôles et validation après intervention
* Les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective
* La remise en état d'équipements électromécaniques industriels
### Le profil que nous recherchons ###
Vous êtes issu d'une formation d'**électromécanicien, automaticien, mécanicien-électricien** ou d'une formation technique équivalente.
Mais au-delà du diplôme, c'est surtout votre expérience pratique qui nous intéresse.
Vous êtes à l'aise lorsqu'il faut passer d'un **schéma électrique à un roulement**, d'une mesure d'isolement à un démontage mécanique, puis comprendre l'origine réelle d'une panne.
Vous travaillez avec méthode, précision et autonomie et vous accordez de l'importance à la qualité du travail réalisé.
### Vous marquez des points supplémentaires si vous connaissez ###
* Les moteurs électriques AC et DC
* Le bobinage ou la réfection de moteurs
* Les systèmes tournants
* Les pompes, ventilateurs ou réducteurs
* Les contrôles électriques et mesures d'isolement
* La maintenance ou la révision électromécanique en atelier
**Vous n'avez pas besoin de maîtriser l'ensemble de ces domaines.**
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne disposant de **bonnes bases électromécaniques, d'une véritable logique de diagnostic et de l'envie de comprendre ce qu'elle répare.**
### Pourquoi cette opportunité ? ###
Parce qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de maintenance où l'on se contente de changer des composants.
Vous rejoignez un environnement dans lequel **le savoir-faire technique, le diagnostic et la réparation ont encore une vraie valeur**.

* Une activité technique variée
* Des équipements industriels différents
* Un atelier disposant d'un véritable savoir-faire
* Une équipe expérimentée
* Un poste stable
* Des compétences techniques reconnues et valorisées
### Vous vous reconnaissez ? ###
Vous aimez ouvrir une machine pour comprendre ce qui ne fonctionne plus.
Vous préférez **trouver la panne plutôt que changer des pièces au hasard**.
Et lorsqu'un moteur repart après votre intervention, vous savez exactement pourquoi.
**Alors votre profil nous intéresse.**
### Candidature ###
Chaque candidature est étudiée avec **attention, discrétion et confidentialité** dans le cadre de notre activité de conseil et d'accompagnement des entreprises industrielles.

s.t:
As an EV Field Service Engineer , you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products.
This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future.
Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel , with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites.
Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics
Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues.
Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults.
Troubleshoot communication with local inverters, energy meters, onboard controllers, and customer SCADA systems.
Clearly explain issues and resolutions to customers, building confidence in Sungrow products.
Implement proactive actions—including remote reboots, configuration changes, and firmware updates—to maximise fleet availability and minimise downtime.
Commissioning & Field Troubleshooting
Align commissioning activities for new EV chargers with customer requirements.
Provide clear remote guidance and support for commissioning tasks.
Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning with installers, electricians, platform technicians, and other stakeholders.
Integrate EV chargers into customer systems, including local grids, EMS controllers, OCPP backends, and shared-meter arrangements.
Configure systems to ensure safe, reliable, and seamless operation.
Lead on-site troubleshooting for complex technical issues and replace faulty components in compliance with electrical safety regulations.
Specialised Tool Expertise
Develop strong expertise in Sungrow monitoring and diagnostic tools.
Use these tools to identify potential issues early and support proactive maintenance.
Product Improvement & Data Management Quality Issue Reporting
Identify and document recurring quality issues for Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams.
Contribute practical field insights that support continuous product improvement.
Database Management

Afin de renforcer notre département Facilities & Services chez SICPA, nous recherchons un(e):
**Technicien de maintenance**
**Mission générale**
Le Technicien de maintenance assure de manière autonome et proactive l-exploitation, la maintenance, le dépannage et le suivi des infrastructures techniques du site de Florissant, comprenant notamment les installations desservant les laboratoires, le Data Center et les infrastructures générales du site.

Il est responsable des installations techniques depuis leur production jusqu-à leur distribution ou point de raccordement aux équipements utilisateurs, dans le respect des règles de sécurité, des normes et des prescriptions en vigueur.
**Domaines techniques concernés:**
**Électricité**
* Production et distribution électrique du site.
* Maintenance et dépannage des installations électriques jusqu-au point de raccordement.
* Intervention selon les compétences et autorisations requises.
**Sanitaire et chauffage**
* Production et distribution de chaleur et d-eau.
* Maintenance des réseaux, pompes, vannes et installations associées.
* Diagnostic et dépannage des installations.
**Production et distribution de froid**
* Production de froid et installations associées.
* Réseaux et circuits de distribution.
* Pompes, vannes et équipements périphériques.
* Suivi des paramètres de fonctionnement et dépannage.
**Ventilation**
* Exploitation et maintenance des installations de ventilation et d-extraction d-air.
* Ventilation des locaux, notamment des laboratoires et des zones techniques.
* Suivi des débits, températures, pressions et paramètres de fonctionnement.
* Diagnostic et dépannage des installations.
**Air comprimé**
* Production et distribution d-air comprimé.
* Maintenance des compresseurs et réseaux de distribution.
* Surveillance des installations et recherche d-anomalies ou de fuites.
**Automation et supervision**
* Exploitation et suivi des systèmes d-automation et de supervision des infrastructures techniques.
* Surveillance des alarmes et des paramètres des installations.
* Diagnostic des défauts et interventions dans la limite des compétences et autorisations.
**Autonomie et organisation**
Le Technicien de maintenance travaille de manière autonome et organise son activité quotidienne en fonction des priorités, des urgences et des besoins du site.
Il assure le suivi des interventions, identifie les anomalies et propose des solutions adaptées. Il collabore avec les entreprises externes ou les spécialistes lorsque les compétences nécessaires dépassent son périmètre d-intervention.
**Service de piquet**
Participation au service de piquet environ une fois par mois, lorsque l-effectif de l-équipe est au complet, afin d-assurer la continuité de fonctionnement des infrastructures techniques des trois sites : Florissant, Campus et Bussigny.
**Responsabilité principale**
Le Technicien de maintenance contribue directement à la disponibilité, à la fiabilité, à la sécurité et à la pérennité des infrastructures techniques, dans son domaine de compétence et jusqu-aux points de distribution ou de raccordement.

## À propos de l-ETH Zurich ##
L-ETH Zurich est l-une des meilleures universités techniques et scientifiques du monde. Nous sommes connus pour notre enseignement d-excellence, notre recherche fondamentale pionnière et le transfert direct des nouvelles connaissances à la société.

Plus de 30 000 personnes de plus de 120 pays trouvent chez nous un environnement qui favorise la pensée autonome et un climat qui inspire l-excellence. Au cœur de l-Europe et connecté mondialement, nous développons ensemble des solutions pour les défis globaux d-aujourd-hui et de demain.

* Generation, completion and return of work orders.

## Firmenbeschreibung ##
Unsere Kundin ist ein global bekanntes Unternehmen, welches mit Ihren innovativen Lösungen und Technologien zu den Marktführern in Ihrer Branche zählt. Das Produkteportfolio umfasst eine breite Palette von Produkten und Dienstleistungen, darunter elektrische Systeme und Komponenten, Industrieautomationssysteme, Roboter und Antriebsysteme.

Das Unternehmen legt grossen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die zur Reduzierung von Umweltauswirkungen und zur Verbesserung der Energieeffizienz beitragen. Für diese Arbeiten suchen sie einen Wartungsspezialisten für den Unterhalt Ihrer Baugruppen und Komponenten.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
Als Mechaniker in der Wartung und im Unterhalt führen Sie folgende Arbeiten aus:
* Reparieren von Baugruppen und Komponenten
* Prüfung von Geräten, Baugruppen und gesamten Systemen (Service- und Serie Geschäft)
* Einhaltung von Leistungsvorgaben: Qualität, Quantität und Termine
* Einhaltung Arbeitssicherheit
* Auftrags-Problemlösung in Zusammenarbeit mit PP, Engineering, Konstruktion und Montage
* Verbesserungsmassnahmen einbringen und Qualitätsmeldungen erstellen
* Nachführen der pers. Arbeitsunterlagen und Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Prüfanweisungen
* Durchführen von Kundenabnahmen
## Wir erwarten ##
* Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Automatiker, Elektromonteur oder Elektroniker
* Mehr als 2 Jahre Berufserfahrungen
* Zusatzausbildung in Energietechnik (ev. Techniker HF) von Vorteil
* Gute EDV Kenntnisse, SAP von Vorteil
* Deutsch fliessend, Englisch von Vorteil
* Gute Sozialkompetenzen
* Verantwortungsbewusst
* Erfahrung im Unterhalt oder Wartung von Maschinen (von Vorteil)
## Wir bieten ##
Unsere Kundin bietet Ihnen interessante Aufgaben in einem hoch motivierten Team und einen offenen Kommunikationsstil. Durch einen individuellen und praxisorientierten Einarbeitungsplan hilft Sie Ihnen, schnell fachliche Sicherheit zu gewinnen, um selbstständig mit hoher Eigenverantwortung arbeiten zu können.

Auch nach der Einarbeitungsphase bietet unsere Kundin vielfältige Möglichkeiten der beruflichen Entwicklung und unterstützt Sie bei der Realisierung Ihrer Karriereziele. Individuelle Entwicklungspläne mit gezielten Fördermassnahmen helfen Ihnen, Ihre Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world.

This position is part of the Service Organization located in the Portland, OR and will be fully remote. At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time.
You will be a part of the Field Service Team reporting to the PNW Field Service Leader and responsible for ensuring optimal performance of Beckman Coulter equipment. This position services Automation, Immunoassay, Chemistry, Urinalysis, Clinical IT, Microbiology and/or Hematology Platforms. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy the challenge of identifying solutions, excel in an autonomous role and want to work to build a world-class service organization—read on.

s.h: In this role, you will have the opportunity to
s.t:
Working independently, handle troubleshooting, installation, preventative maintenance, and service repair needs of Beckman Coulter equipment, including providing excellent and efficient service to Beckman Coulter’s customers, along with technical training on products.
Maintain accurate customer service logs and internal service records, order repair parts, and adhere to cycle times. Utilize business systems such as OBI, Salesforce, and SharePoint for Service Call Planning and advancing team goals.
Engage with internal and external stakeholders, understanding and meeting their requirements, while also helping train newer Field Service Engineers.

1-year experience diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electromechanical, robotics, electronic equipment, and/or instrumentation

Ability to travel, overnight, within territory or locations primarily Portland, OR. Availability to travel overnight 15%

Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 50 lb, any other physical requirements

2+ years’ experience of advanced troubleshooting, installation, validation, preventative maintenance, modifications and/or service repair.
Developing positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, leading to increased customer satisfaction, and supporting long-term retention

Work Schedule

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As a Field Service Engineer II at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll contribute to delivering excellent service for sophisticated analytical and scientific instruments. Working with customers across research, industrial, and healthcare settings, you'll install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair complex equipment while providing exceptional customer service. This position offers opportunities to work with advanced technology while contributing to scientific advancement and innovation.

Advanced Degree, no prior experience required, or Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of hands-on technical experience installing, troubleshooting and repairing complex analytical instruments
Preferred Fields of Study: Electronics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or related technical field
Additional relevant certifications are advantageous
Strong electronics and mechanical troubleshooting skills with ability to diagnose issues down to component level
Experience with ultra-high vacuum systems and high voltage equipment preferred
Excellent customer service and communication skills, both written and verbal
Strong organizational and time management capabilities
Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and service management software
Ability to read and interpret technical documentation and schematics
Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 50-75% within assigned territory
Physical ability to lift up to 40 lbs and work in various laboratory environments
Proficiency in English required; additional languages beneficial
Strong problem-solving abilities and capacity to work independently
Adherence to safety protocols and quality standards
Ability to respond to customer needs with short notice
Ability to effectively train and support customers on equipment operation
Experience documenting service activities and preparing detailed reports
Demonstrated success in meeting customer satisfaction goals

s.h: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab
s.t:
Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung
Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. Wenn deine Bewerbung passt, kontaktieren wir dich für ein erstes Gespräch.
Schritt 2: Gespräche
Im Vorstellungsgespräch \- telefonisch, vor Ort oder online \- möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir überprüfen, ob deine Erwartungen an die Stelle mit unseren übereinstimmen, welche Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten du mitbringst, ob dich unsere Kultur anspricht und wie du ins Team passt. Bei beidseitigem Interesse und je nach Stelle finden mehrere Gespräche statt. Alle deine Fragen zur Stelle, zum Team oder zu den Anstellungsbedingungen sind immer willkommen.
Schritt 3: Weitere Schritte im Prozess
Je nach Stelle vereinbaren wir einen Probe\- oder Schnuppertag, stellen dir eine fachliche Aufgabe, organisieren ein Treffen mit dem Team oder laden zu einem Assessment ein. In der Regel gehören auch Referenzauskünfte zu unserem Bewerbungsablauf. Über alle Schritte im Prozess wirst du transparent informiert.
Schritt 4: Bewerbungsentscheid
Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.
